articles.title: “Not caring about low character players”: Chiefs face backlash over Justin Tucker signing
articles.summary: The Kansas City Chiefs are facing backlash after signing Justin Tucker to their practice squad.
articles.body: The Kansas City Chiefs are facing backlash after signing Justin Tucker to their practice squad. While the move gives the team another option at kicker, it has also sparked a heated debate among fans, with some questioning the decision and others coming to Tucker’s defense.Why is Justin Tucker’s signing causing outrage amongst fans?For those living under a rock, Tucker, widely regarded as one of the NFL’s most successful kickers who has faced sexual misconduct allegations involving massage therapists. He denied the allegations, and the NFL later suspended him for 10 games for violating its personal conduct policy following its investigation.He was not criminally charged in connection with the allegations. However, the absence of criminal charges does not mean a court determined that the allegations were false. The NFL’s disciplinary process was separate from the criminal justice system.This background has made his move to Kansas City particularly controversial, with some fans questioning whether the Chiefs should have signed him while others believe he deserves an opportunity to return to the league.The reaction was a whole spectrum, with fans criticizing the Chiefs’ front office, discussing the allegations against Tucker and questioning how the team’s decision should be viewed.One user shared a short but sarcastic reaction, writing, “Chiefs front office.” Although the comment was brief, it was to criticize the team’s management for bringing Tucker into the organization.Another one commented, “Andy Reid has a long history of not caring about low character players, low morals coach, no one ever talks about it.”For fans, the move is not just about football but also about the message the team sends by giving Tucker another opportunity in the NFL. However, not everyone agreed with the criticism.While some supporters questioned the Chiefs’ decision, others argued that Tucker should not be judged without considering the legal outcome of the allegations against him.One user pushed back against the criticism, writing, “Ok… anyone can acuse anyone of anything. What were the legal repercussions and what did the legal system determine?”The Chiefs added Tucker to their practice squad as the team dealt with concerns about its kicking situation. Harrison Butker remains the team's established kicker, meaning Tucker's arrival does not automatically make him the starter. The signing gives Kansas City another option if its kicking problems continue. However, the team must now deal with the public reaction surrounding its decision.For now, the backlash shows that Tucker's arrival is about more than his performance on the field. With fans split between criticizing the Chiefs and defending the kicker, the decision has created another talking point for the franchise.Whether Tucker eventually earns a spot on the active roster remains to be seen, but his signing has already sparked a debate that extends well beyond football.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Chiefs billionaire heiress Gracie Hunt pushes fashion boundaries as her signature look continues to evolve
articles.summary: Gracie Hunt has built a public image that goes well beyond her family's connection to the Kansas City Chiefs.
articles.body: Gracie Hunt has built a public image that goes well beyond her family's connection to the Kansas City Chiefs. As the daughter of team owner Clark Hunt, she grew up around football, but her personal style has taken its own path. From casual sportswear and running shorts to sparkling gowns, bold red outfits and metallic dresses, her wardrobe has changed with each new chapter of her life. Her journey also reflects her experience in beauty pageants, her early love of soccer and her growing presence in the fashion world.Gracie Hunt’s early style and beauty pageant transformationBefore becoming known for glamorous outfits, Gracie Hunt preferred comfortable clothes. Older photos on her Instagram show her wearing trainers, shorts, simple tops and minimal makeup. At the time, her interests leaned more towards sports than fashion.Soccer was her first love. In an interview with People in 2025, Gracie explained, "I wanted to be the next Mia Hamm, and soccer was my first love. ... My grandfather, Lamar Hunt, actually helped bring Major League Soccer to the United States."However, four concussions forced her to reconsider her sporting ambitions. She later turned to beauty pageants, following in the footsteps of her mother, Tavia Hunt, who won Miss Kansas USA in 1993.The transition was not instant. Tavia initially questioned whether pageantry suited her daughter's sporty manner. As Gracie recalled in an interview with the New York Post, her mother told her, "I'm not sure [pageants are a good idea] because you walk like a soccer tomboy, but we can give it a shot."With her mother's guidance, Gracie refined her walk and began experimenting with more formal clothing. In 2016, she won Miss Teen Texas International, wearing elegant gowns that marked a clear shift from her earlier wardrobe. She won the title again in 2018, further establishing her presence in the pageant world.Pink, purple and scarlet soon became defining colours. Her outfits featured sparkling details, statement earrings and carefully styled hair, creating the polished look associated with beauty queens.From metallic dresses to Kansas City Chiefs-inspired fashionAs Gracie Hunt's public profile grew, her fashion choices expanded beyond pageant gowns. During the winter of 2019, she embraced coordinated outfits, including black coats, fur-lined boots and matching separates. She also experimented with crop tops and bold looks during a trip to Paris.The pandemic brought another change. Gracie returned to athletic clothing, wearing running shorts, sweatshirts and yoga pants while preparing for the Miss USA competition. She also worked with a walking coach to improve her stage presence.In 2021, after winning Miss Kansas USA, she combined polished outfits with her charitable commitments. Her wardrobe included a royal blue blazer and matching shorts, paired with heels and her crown.Metallic fashion later became a favourite. In 2023, Gracie wore sparkling gold and silver outfits to high-profile events, including the NFL Commissioner's Super Bowl party. A silver puffer jacket at the Chiefs' Super Bowl parade also blended her fashion interests with team pride.By the 2024 to 2025 season, red and gold had become prominent in her game-day wardrobe. She launched a clothing line with Wear by Erin Andrews, including a red Chiefs corset with gold chain straps.Gracie Hunt's style evolution reflects more than changing trends. Each phase connects to her interests, experiences and public roles. Whether she wears athletic basics, a dramatic gown or Chiefs-inspired fashion, she continues to shape an image that combines family legacy, pageantry and personal expression.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Travis Kelce's $5.35 million Ohio mansion plans hit another costly snag over an unexpected property issue
articles.summary: Travis Kelce wanted to put down roots in the Cleveland area, close to the place he has called home for much of his life.
articles.body: Travis Kelce wanted to put down roots in the Cleveland area, close to the place he has called home for much of his life. But the Kansas City Chiefs tight end and his plans for a private family life have reportedly run into an unexpected obstacle. His $5.35 million Ohio mansion has become the centre of a neighbourhood dispute over proposed security upgrades. The controversy has reportedly left Kelce and Taylor Swift upset, with concerns about privacy, safety and relations with their new neighbours adding pressure to their plans for the property.Travis Kelce's Ohio mansion security plans spark neighbourhood disputeThe dispute centres on proposed changes to the couple's property in Bratenahl, Cleveland. According to reports, the plans include a six-foot fence and additional trees intended to create a stronger barrier around the mansion.For Kelce, the move to Ohio carries personal significance. The NFL star grew up in the area and reportedly wanted to build a family life close to his roots. However, the proposed changes have drawn objections from some residents, who have raised concerns about the impact on the neighbourhood.The disagreement reportedly extends beyond the fence itself. A shared sewer line has also become part of the discussions, with the couple offering to cover costs associated with relocating the old pipe to accommodate the planned landscaping and security work.Despite those efforts, the situation has attracted unwanted attention. Reports have also described drones circling the property before the security plans were finalised, adding another layer to the couple's reported concerns about privacy.A source quoted by Heat World said the couple had tried to avoid conflict and were willing to pay for work that might otherwise have been shared with neighbours.“Taylor and Travis are genuinely very upset about this. The last thing they wanted was to have any sort of friction with their neighbours. They have tried so hard to make sure people would be happy - already paid for all sorts of work that might normally be split between the neighbours and, knowing Taylor, she’ll gladly pay for anything else that the neighbours might need as a result of the trees they are adding to their property.”Travis Kelce's privacy concerns go beyond neighbourhood objectionsThe disagreement also raises a broader question about how public figures can protect their homes while respecting the concerns of the people living nearby.For Kelce, whose NFL career and relationship with Swift attract considerable attention, maintaining a secure private space may be an important part of establishing a home away from the spotlight. The reported security proposals are intended to address more than curious onlookers, according to the source.“It's incredibly stressful; this isn’t just about wanting privacy from all the fans and lookie-loos - there are stalkers and genuine threats to their safety that they need to prepare for. It’s a little shocking to them that there’s no understanding of that - these changes aren’t cosmetic, they’re the difference between Taylor feeling safe in her home and being at risk.”The comments reflect the couple's reported concerns, although the specific threats have not been independently detailed in the available account.For now, the Ohio mansion dispute highlights the challenge of balancing residential security with neighbourhood expectations. Whether the proposed changes move forward remains unclear, leaving questions about the couple's plans for their Cleveland-area home unanswered.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: NFL Power Rankings: Who Is the New No. 1 Team After Chiefs, 49ers’ Losses?
articles.summary: The Minnesota Vikings have taken over the top spot in the NFL power rankings after Week 7 delivered losses for the Kansas City Chiefs and San Francisco 49ers...
articles.body:
The Minnesota Vikings have taken over the top spot in the NFL power rankings after Week 7 delivered losses for the Kansas City Chiefs and San Francisco 49ers. Minnesota's 16-10 win over Indianapolis left it as the league's only undefeated team, giving the club a rise as the season moves forward.

The Vikings improved to 6-0 with a performance built around their defense, which continues to set the team's identity. Minnesota climbed three places, moving from fourth to first, while other lists also placed the club near the top. The shift reflects both the team's unbeaten record and the stumbles of previously favored contenders.

Defensive coordinator Brian Flores has helped create an aggressive unit that has made life difficult for opposing offenses. Minnesota held Indianapolis to 10 points and limited the Colts to six through three quarters, keeping the game within reach even as its own offense struggled to find consistent rhythm. The defense's ability to produce pressure and disrupt plays has become a central reason for the Vikings' early success.

The offense, however, remains a significant question. Minnesota has not consistently matched its defensive production, and the passing game has struggled to generate yardage at a high level. Quarterback Kyler Murray will need to deliver more steady results, particularly as the schedule grows more demanding and opponents have additional time to prepare for the Vikings' defensive strengths.

Minnesota Vikings Become New No. 1 Team in the Latest NFL Power Rankings

Minnesota has emerged as the top team in the league at this point of the season. This is detailed more in the latest power rankings posted by the league's official website.

Week 7 claimed two of the three remaining undefeated teams in the NFL, leaving the Vikings as the last unbeaten squad standing. They climbed to the mountaintop by winning in their familiar fashion, with defense leading the way. Brian Flores' unit is unquestionably elite and getting more creative with its approach each week. If the offense ever catches up, Minnesota will become a strong Super Bowl favorite.

That challenge could determine how long Minnesota stays atop the rankings. The team's upcoming slate includes several difficult matchups, offering a test of whether its undefeated start can translate into sustained dominance. The Vikings have earned their place through six wins, but the margin for error may narrow as they face stronger competition and need more balance on offense.

Minnesota is the league's standard-bearer, powered by a defense that has repeatedly kept games under control. The top ranking is a milestone, but maintaining it will require the offense to improve and the defense to continue its high level of play. The Vikings have seized the opportunity created by Week 7, and the next stretch will show whether they can hold on firmly.

articles.title: Chiefs OC Eric Bieniemy says wife Mia is 'doing great' 3 months after surviving shooting
articles.summary: Bieniemy said Thursday that rehab is going well for Mia, who was shot in the chest and arm in July. Their son, Elijah, was arrested in connection with the ca...
articles.body:
Kansas City Chiefs offensive coordinator Eric Bieniemy has shared a positive update on his wife Mia, three months after she was shot in their family home .

When speaking to reporters on Thursday, Bieniemy said that Mia was doing well enough to go on a trip with friends this past weekend.

"She's doing great. She actually went on a trip this weekend," Bieniemy said. "She was a rockstar, obviously. "Her rehab has been going great. She actually had an opportunity to come out here and hang out and I'm sure I got on her nerves," he joked.

"She's doing great. She actually went on a trip this weekend," Bieniemy said. "She was a rockstar, obviously.

"Her rehab has been going great. She actually had an opportunity to come out here and hang out and I'm sure I got on her nerves," he joked.

Mia, 57, was shot in the arm and chest at their family home in Loudoun County, Virginia, on July 26. She was hospitalized with multiple gunshot wounds.

Elijah Bieniemy, the 27-year-old son of Eric and Mia, was arrested and charged with the shooting the following day.

In August, three weeks after the shooting, Bieniemy returned to practice and told reporters that Mia was on the "road to recovery."

"It's one of the main reasons why I'm back here, because of her recovery," Eric Bieniemy said. "She's truly a soldier. She's a saint and it's been incredible to watch. But I know I was driving her and a bunch of my family members crazy in the house, so she was like, 'You have my blessing to leave.' It was time to get back."

Last month, Elijah Bieniemy was found fit to stand trial after a psychological evaluation. A public defender who represented Elijah earlier in the trial (he now has new representation) wrote in a filing that "the defendant appears to suffer from significant mental health issues."

Eric Bieniemy, a decorated offensive coach, returned to the Chiefs' sideline this season as offensive coordinator, a role he served in from 2018-2022.

He served in various assistant coaching roles for the Washington Commanders, UCLA and Chicago Bears in between stints in Kansas City.

articles.title: Packers’ Josh Jacobs Had an ‘Interesting’ Comment Ahead of His First Lambeau Field Game in 2026 Season
articles.summary: Green Bay Packers running back Josh Jacobs has finally seen action in the 2026 NFL season after getting removed from the NFL’s commissioner exempt list. Jaco...
articles.body:
Green Bay Packers running back Josh Jacobs has finally seen action in the 2026 NFL season after getting removed from the NFL's commissioner exempt list.

Jacobs missed the first six weeks of the season while he was placed on that list, stemming from his arrest in the offseason over misdemeanor charges after an altercation with his then-girlfriend in May.

The three-time Pro Bowl tailback returned to action in Green Bay's Week 7 game against the Detroit Lions at Ford Field in Detroit, and he's about to make his first appearance at Lambeau Field in Green Bay for a Week 8 Thursday Night Football showdown against the visiting Carolina Panthers .

"It's going to be interesting. Obviously, like primetime, Lambeau Field, Thursday night, it's gonna be electric," the former Alabama Crimson Tide star running back told reporters via ESPN's Rob Demovsky. "Looking forward to seeing our fans. Going out there and playing some good ball."

Will Jacobs, Packers' Rushing Attack Shine in Week 8?

It will be interesting to see what kind of reception Jacobs will get from Packers fans. He was booed by Detroit fans in Week 7, and he could hear the same thing from at least a few fans in Green Bay.

In any case, Jacobs is expected to help Green Bay's run game that has been arguably the worst in the NFL thus far.

The Packers are averaging fewer than 60 rushing yards per game and are also last in the NFL with only 2.9 yards per carry.

Against the Lions, Jacobs and company came up with only 60 rushing yards on 19 carries. Jacobs had 36 rushing yards on 11 carries in that contest.

However, there is a reason to believe that Green Bay will have a great night on the ground versus the Panthers, as Carolina is allowing over 150 rushing yards per game.

articles.title: Mina Kimes’ Captionless Post After Chiefs’ Justin Tucker Signing Sparks Reactions
articles.summary: The Kansas City Chiefs’ decision to sign veteran NFL kicker Justin Tucker to their practice squad has caught a lot of people by surprise, especially because...
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs' decision to sign veteran NFL kicker Justin Tucker to their practice squad has caught a lot of people by surprise, especially because of his history — off the field.

Tucker was cut by the Baltimore Ravens in May of 2025 amid sexual misconduct accusations from over a dozen massage therapists. He was later suspended for 10 games by the NFL before being eligible for reinstatement last November.

Tucker was able to get tryouts with the New Orleans Saints and the Indianapolis Colts since, but wasn't signed.

On Thursday, it was reported that the Chiefs were signing Tucker to a practice squad contract, a move that raised eyebrows.

Following the news of Tucker's addition to the Chiefs' practice squad, ESPN's Mina Kimes posted on X without a caption, attaching a screenshot of a report detailing the accusations against the kicker.

Kimes didn't need a caption to sum up what she really feels about this development involving the Chiefs and Tucker.

It also clearly turned heads online, with nearly 40,000 likes and over a thousand comments made on her post at the time of this writing.

Chiefs Add Tucker as Insurance Behind Struggling First Option

Kansas City felt it had to add another kicker as insurance amid the struggles of Harrison Butker.

So far in the 2026 NFL season, Butker has gone 11/16 on his field-goal tries, and two of his misses came in Week 7's 20-3 Kansas City loss to the reigning Super Bowl champions Seattle Seahawks on the road.

What's interesting, however, is that Tucker wasn't great either in the most recent season he played in the NFL. In 2024, he went 22/30 on his kicks for a 73.3 percent success rate — the lowest of his career.

Kansas City enters Week 8 of the 2026 season with a 5-1 record and will face the Denver Broncos in a road game this coming Sunday.

articles.title: Chicago Just Changed the Entire Super Bowl Race! Jeffery Simmons Could Make the Bears Nearly Impossible to Beat!
articles.summary: The Chicago Bears just sent a massive warning to the rest of the NFL, and it might have completely changed the Super Bowl picture. Chicago pulled off one of...
articles.body:
The Chicago Bears just sent a massive warning to the rest of the NFL, and it might have completely changed the Super Bowl picture.

Chicago pulled off one of the biggest moves of the season by acquiring Tennessee Titans superstar defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons in a blockbuster trade. The Bears gave up their 2027 and 2028 first-round picks, along with a 2027 fourth-round selection, to bring the four-time Pro Bowler to Chicago. They also received a 2028 fifth-round pick in the deal.

And honestly, this is the kind of move that can turn a good football team into a legitimate championship contender.

The Bears entered the season with plenty of offensive firepower behind Caleb Williams and head coach Ben Johnson. At 5-2, they had already shown they could compete with some of the best teams in the league. However, their biggest weakness remained on the defensive side of the football, particularly when it came to creating pressure up the middle.

That problem just got a whole lot smaller.

Simmons has already recorded four sacks, 38 tackles and six tackles for loss through seven games this season. He is coming off a dominant 2025 campaign in which he recorded 11 sacks and earned First-Team All-Pro honors.

Now imagine putting that kind of player alongside Montez Sweat and Grady Jarrett.

Opposing quarterbacks are going to have a nightmare trying to find time in the pocket. Simmons gives Chicago an elite interior presence who can disrupt plays, collapse the pocket and make life easier for everyone else on the defensive line.

The move has already sent shockwaves through the betting market. Chicago's Super Bowl odds improved from +1400 to +1100 at BetMGM, putting the Bears among the top teams in the championship race. Some sportsbooks have moved them even higher.

But the biggest takeaway is that Chicago isn't just hoping to compete anymore. General manager Ryan Poles is making it clear that this team believes its championship window is wide open.

Giving up two first-round picks is an enormous gamble, and the Bears are going to need Simmons to make a major impact for that price to pay off. Still, when you have a young quarterback, an explosive offense and a defense that just added one of the best players at his position, sitting back and waiting isn't always the answer.

The Bears have officially pushed their chips into the middle of the table.

San Francisco, Seattle, Los Angeles and the rest of the NFC contenders better take notice. Chicago just made one of the boldest moves of the entire season, and there is a real argument that the Bears now have everything needed to make a run at the Lombardi Trophy.

articles.summary: Come and watch a football game with us!
articles.body:
Hello, good evening and welcome to week eight of the NFL season.

The Milwaukee Brewers won their first championship last night. And now a presumably VERY hungover Packers fanbase will be filing into Lambeau Field to watch their beloved Packers.

Just don't expect a lot of loud cheering; or at least a lot of swearing and groaning when the cheering does happen.

Who: Carolina Panthers (3-3) at Green Bay Packers (4-3)

When: Thursday, October 29, 7:15 p.m. CST

Why: Because remember in the doldrums of the offseason when you were begging for a Cardinals/Browns game? This game should be better than that.
